summary: Review-required audit trail for the live shadow-copy cleanup card. The app already surfaces the vssadmin-based action and repo docs map the tweak id to the same delete flow, but the card still lives only in the first-party provider and has not yet been promoted into the validated research-provider surface.

setting.name: Clear Shadow Copies
setting.casual_explanation: This deletes Windows shadow copies to reclaim disk space, which also removes restore-point style snapshots backed by VSS.
setting.why_people_change_it: People run it when they need disk space or want to clear out old snapshot data and accept losing those restore points.
setting.tradeoffs_overview: It can free disk space, but it is destructive because shadow copies and restore-point style snapshots are removed permanently. This record documents the shipped app behavior without yet promoting the card into the research-provider surface.
setting.professional_notes: The live app models this card as a command tweak that detects with vssadmin list shadows and applies vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet. Repo cleanup docs and tweak provenance both map the tweak id to the same cleanup action. The record stays review-required until command-backed cleanup cards move through the research-provider path.
